content: Official Xbox Accessibility Guidelines recommend redundant channels for critical cues, readable configurable text and captions, no color-only information, adjustable difficulty and discrete assists, longer or player-advanced text timing, and reduced flashing/motion options. For boss fights, every lethal attack should combine a named text cue, distinct silhouette/particle shape, sound, and sufficient wind-up; v1 should include story/easy/normal presets, reduced particles/screenshake, captions, and configurable dialogue duration.
